chapters.title: Messaging model and document exchange flow
Third-party access point integration and authentication
Purchase order matching for incoming e-documents
Manual Matching Workflow and Purchase Order Updates

features.name: E-documents core app
features.description: A new dedicated application for e-documents functionality, separate from the base app to maintain compatibility with existing partner-based localizations in non-Microsoft supported countries.
caveats: Some e-documents functionality remains in base app to avoid breaking changes
Aims for more than 80% of common features

features.name: Third-party access point integration app
features.description: An app for connecting with third-party access points and service providers, including authentication model, communication model, and messaging model for external e-document services.
caveats: Currently supporting only one access point
Planning to add more access points in future

features.name: Data exchange definition for e-documents
features.description: A feature allowing users to map incoming and outgoing documents with specific data exchange definitions instead of using code, providing a faster alternative to code-based format implementation.
caveats: Must configure supported document types on the service
Requires document sending profile selection on customer

features.name: Danish localization with PayPal and OBL
features.description: Localization for Denmark supporting both PayPal B3 and OBL formats, fully compliant with Danish requirements and regulations.

features.name: Belgian localization with PayPal
features.description: Localization for Belgium delivering PayPal format support, fully compliant with Belgian requirements and regulations.

features.name: Purchase order matching for incoming e-documents
features.description: Functionality to automatically match incoming electronic purchase documents with existing purchase orders in the system, or to automatically create new purchase orders if none exist. Supports one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one matching.
caveats: Manual matching available as fallback if Copilot cannot be used

features.name: Copilot-assisted purchase order matching
features.description: AI-powered matching capability for incoming e-documents to purchase orders, built on top of the purchase order matching framework.
caveats: Manual matching available as alternative when Copilot cannot be used

features.name: E-documents demo data module
features.description: A new Contoso demo module providing pre-configured items, setup, and sample data for both sales and purchase processes to test e-documents functionality without manual file creation.
caveats: Requires Commerce module and Warehouse module to be enabled first

features.name: E-Document Framework
features.description: A new framework enabling electronic document handling for both sales and purchase processes with built-in workflow automation and audit capabilities.
caveats: Requires Warehouse module and Comma module to be enabled first
No service integration included in demo

features.name: Peppol Format E-Document Service
features.description: E-document service supporting the Peppol format with two solution types: code solution based on existing XMLports and a data exchange solution.
caveats: Code solution based on pre-existing XMLports
Data exchange solution is separate approach

features.name: E-Document Workflow Automation
features.description: Background workflow that automatically executes when a supported document type is posted, exports the document in selected format, and logs all actions for audit purposes.
caveats: Runs in background jobs
Would send documents if service integration is configured
User does not interact with workflow directly

features.name: E-Document Line Matching Interface
features.description: Bank reconciliation-style interface for matching e-document imported lines to purchase order lines with visual indicators, quantity tracking, and detailed match inspection capabilities.
caveats: Supports multi-select and many-to-one or one-to-many matching
Cost differences are allowed with notification
Matching quantity must equal document quantity

features.name: E-Document Cost Variance Handling
features.description: System allows matching e-document lines to purchase order lines even when costs differ, with notifications to ensure user awareness of the variance before applying to purchase order.
caveats: User must manually accept cost variance
Purchase order will be updated with received cost if accepted

features.name: Purchase Order Update with E-Document Data
features.description: Matched e-document lines automatically update purchase order with correct cost, discount, quantity to invoice, vendor invoice number, and document date from the e-document.
caveats: Updates are applied after manual matching approval
Final invoice posting still requires user action

features.name: Sales Invoice E-Document Export
features.description: Ability to post sales invoices and automatically export them as e-documents in configured format through the workflow framework with reference number support.
caveats: Requires document sending profile with e-documents enabled on customer
Peppol format requires reference number field

features.name: E-Document File Export and Download
features.description: Users can download exported e-document files to inspect format and content when file size is recorded in the system.
caveats: Only available when file size is present

features.name: E-documents framework extensibility
features.description: Framework allowing partners to extend e-documents functionality with additional features, localization support, and custom connections to service providers.
caveats: Partner-based localization recommended over previous approaches

features.name: Document format interface
features.description: Interface for creating and receiving electronic documents, defining how data is read from Business Central and translated back.

features.name: Integration interface for messaging
features.description: Interface for sending and receiving messages to integrate with external service providers and e-invoicing systems.

features.name: E-document helper code units
features.description: Set of helper code units provided in the framework to assist with e-document processing and extension development.

features.name: Copilot support for e-document extensions
features.description: E-document extensions built on the framework automatically gain native co-pilot feature support without additional implementation.

features.name: Field mapping for export and import
features.description: Capability to translate values during export or import of e-documents before converting between Business Central and electronic document formats.

features.name: Background job processing for e-documents
features.description: E-document processing runs in background jobs to avoid interrupting users working with invoices and documents day-to-day.

features.name: E-document audit trail
features.description: Complete audit trail recording what happens with each e-document allowing visibility into current state and historical changes.

features.name: E-document retention policies
features.description: Configurable retention policies to control how long e-document data is stored before cleanup to manage database size.
caveats: Large tables may impact performance without retention policies

features.name: E-document error handling framework
features.description: Framework catches runtime errors in AL code and presents them to users through error logging via helper code units.

features.name: E-document dashboard and status cards
features.description: Dashboard with quick cards showing current status of e-documents and highlighting items requiring user action.
